---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a privacy-preserving personalization improvement
title: "feature: "
labels: enhancement
---

## User or research problem

What problem would this solve, and who is affected?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful, reversible change.

## Validation and trust boundary

- What synthetic or approved data will test it?
- How will consent, isolation, deletion and user correction work?
- What privacy, poisoning, stale-memory, safety or feedback-loop failures must be rejected?
- Are new services, models, datasets, code or licenses involved?
- What is the incumbent comparison and rollback path?
